question: The value of ( {{x⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾} - {x⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾}{y⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾} + {y⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾}} )( {{x⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾} + {y⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾}} ) is _________.
solution:
**Formula used:**

(a³ + b³) = (a + b)(a² - ab + b²)

**Calculations:**

 ( {{x⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾} - {x⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾}{y⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾} + {y⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾}} )( {{x⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾} + {y⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾}} ) 

Let x¹/³ be t and y¹/³ be p, then

 ( {{x⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾} - {x⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾}{y⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾} + {y⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾}} )( {{x⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾} + {y⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾}} ) 

= (t² - tp + p²)(t + p)

= (t³ + p³)

= x + y

**Hence, The Required value is x + y.**
